accessibility-auditor-agent: Audits codebase files and configurations for compliance with digital accessibility standards (WCAG).
agent-alignment-auditor-agent: Audits agent prompts, configurations, and workflows for consistency, style, formatting, and token limits.
ai-robustness-hardener-agent: Audits AI/ML components and LLM integrations, configuring secure input/output guardrails.
api-contract-architect-agent: Audits API boundaries, designs schemas, and integrates Buf/Spectral Linters.
appsec-hardener-agent: Audits security configurations and scaffolds secure HTTP header middlewares, CORS, and rate limits.
compliance-auditor-agent: Audits and scaffolds security and compliance configurations for industry standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
data-pipeline-architect-agent: Audits data workflows, schemas, retries, and database connection pool configurations.
deployment-engineer-agent: Audits container files, HA replicas, Kubernetes probes, and backup scripts.
embedded-systems-auditor-agent: Audits low-level firmware robustness, static analysis (MISRA), and compiler warning flags.
state-integrity-auditor-agent: Audits codebase state machines, specifications (TLA+), and proof verification harnesses.
fuzz-engineer-agent: Audits parsing blocks to identify crash-prone sections and scaffolds fuzz-testing harnesses.
legal-neutrality-auditor-agent: Audits user-facing UI copy warning alerts, Terms of Service, and UI descriptions for legal neutrality.
notebook-auditor-agent: Audits data science repositories and configures nbstripout pre-commit filters.
observability-engineer-agent: Audits observability configurations, OpenTelemetry integration, and Honeycomb/Grafana dashboards.
performance-auditor-agent: Audits codebase performance setups, benchmarking, and CI performance budgets.
privacy-hardener-agent: Audits data storage schemas and configurations for CCPA/GDPR regulatory privacy compliance.
react-performance-auditor-agent: Audits React client-side rendering speed, re-renders, layout shifts, and bfcache.
resilience-architect-agent: Audits fault-tolerance configurations, retry policies, backoffs, and circuit breakers.
state-hardener-agent: Audits React codebase hooks and states for stale closures, memory leaks, and async fetch race conditions.
supply-chain-auditor-agent: Audits codebase dependencies for vulnerabilities and copyleft licenses.
technical-scribe-agent: Audits and scaffolds ADR documentation systems and generates architecture flowcharts.
qa-engineer-agent: Audits and configures unit, integration, and E2E test runners and code coverage gates.
tool-auditor-agent: Audits recommended packages and libraries against security databases and licensing rules.
tooling-engineer-agent: Safely installs tools and edits config files using AST-based modifications.
toolchain-architect-agent: Audits build target constraints and cross-compilation toolchain parameters.
vcs-workflow-engineer-agent: Audits and configures pre-commit hooks, Conventional Commit validations, and copyright headers.
